svg.aria-label: Mode 1 · split: one model over several cards or machines
svg.text: Mode 1 · split: one model over several cards or machines
ONE server process · ONE model · one scheduler
Main card also keeps: embedding · final norm · lm_head · drafter · sampling
Each card keeps the KV cache of ITS OWN layers only.
Use it when the pack does not fit one card (27B on 16 GB V100s), or to use idle cards.
